# ============================================================
# Fantacalcio Intelligence - production profile
#
# Start with:
#   SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=prod
#
# Required environment variables intentionally have NO fallback.
# Production startup must fail rather than silently use dev secrets.
# ============================================================

server.forward-headers-strategy=framework
server.error.include-message=never
server.error.include-stacktrace=never
server.error.include-exception=false

spring.datasource.username=${DATABASE_USERNAME}
spring.datasource.password=${DATABASE_PASSWORD}

spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.format_sql=false

# Production schema safety: migrations validate and run forward only.
spring.flyway.clean-disabled=true
spring.flyway.validate-on-migrate=true
spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate=false

management.endpoint.health.show-details=never

app.security.admin.username=${ADMIN_USERNAME}

app.security.user.password=${APP_USER_PASSWORD}

app.security.cors.allowed-origins=${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS}
app.security.rate-limit.requests=${RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS:60}
app.security.rate-limit.window=${RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW:1m}

# Safe production default: the scheduler stays disabled until the
# deployment explicitly enables it.
app.data-refresh.scheduler.enabled=${DATA_REFRESH_SCHEDULER_ENABLED:false}

app.fantacalcio-listone.max-redirects=${FANTACALCIO_LISTONE_MAX_REDIRECTS:3}

# Scheduler remains explicitly opt-in through DATA_REFRESH_SCHEDULER_ENABLED.
app.production-automation.stale-threshold=${PRODUCTION_AUTOMATION_STALE_THRESHOLD:2h}
app.fantacalcio-listone.stale-threshold=${FANTACALCIO_LISTONE_STALE_THRESHOLD:2h}
# B71 selective Transfermarkt identity enrichment.
# Both switches are explicit opt-in. No live Transfermarkt access occurs by default.
app.transfermarkt-discovery.enabled=${TRANSFERMARKT_DISCOVERY_ENABLED:false}

project-audit-current.txt:9145: # Fantasy Player Value Model V1
project-audit-current.txt:9149: `B50_FANTASY_VALUE_V1` is a deterministic, rule-based historical fantasy-football value model for the 495 current operational 2026/2027 players. Its only input is the immutable `B49_FEATURES_V1` evidence layer for 2024/2025 and 2025/2026. It does not use age, market value, reputation, league factors, current form, prices, calendar or newly acquired data.
project-audit-current.txt:9151: Fantacalcio is authoritative for fantasy average, rating, PV and goalkeeper evidence. Transfermarkt contributes only certified usage, production and discipline. Missing fantasy evidence for international players remains `NULL`, never zero and never an invented proxy.
project-audit-current.txt:9155: All available components are on 0â€“100 role-relative scales. Fantasy quality uses 80% Fantacalcio fantasy-average role percentile and 20% a B50-derived role percentile of average rating when both exist. Usage reuses the source-aware B49 usage percentile. Production uses the mean of available B49 goal/assist rate percentiles; Fantacalcio rows use source-and-role-relative latest raw goal/assist percentiles because minutes do not exist. The signals are combined once, avoiding raw/per-90 double counting within a player.
project-audit-current.txt:9157: Consistency is inverse role percentile of absolute comparable-season change and exists only for two same-source seasons. Discipline is the inverse role percentile of certified Transfermarkt discipline events per 90 after B49 small-sample exclusion. Goalkeeper-specific value combines penalties-saved percentile (60%) and inverse goals-conceded-per-PV percentile (40%); raw goals conceded are never used. Offensive production is excluded for goalkeepers.
project-audit-current.txt:9161: - P: fantasy quality 45, usage 30, goalkeeper 20, consistency 5.
project-audit-current.txt:9172: Ranks are per role only. Competition ranking is used for equal unrounded scores, with player ID providing deterministic display order but no semantic tie break. Role percentile is inclusive 0â€“100 with average ranks for ties. Component/final/percentile display precision is two decimals; contributions use four decimals, while calculations occur before rounding.
project-audit-current.txt:9176: The database grain is player, reference season and algorithm version. Import is append-only and idempotent; changed output under the same key is a conflict. Formula changes require a new version. Source-mix distributions, component coverage/distributions, correlations, anomalies, golden cases and top/bottom ranks are published under `data/statistics/value-model`.
project-audit-current.txt:9178: The principal limitation is structural source coverage: international-only players have no manufactured fantasy quality, Fantacalcio-only players have no minute-based discipline, and profiles with fewer than two valid components are explicitly unranked. This is evidence uncertainty, not low player value.
project-audit-current.txt:9183: Identity enrichment is deliberately separate from player reconciliation and statistical links.
project-audit-current.txt:9184: It never writes `player_source_mappings`, never changes `player_reconciliation_results.sources_count`,
project-audit-current.txt:9187: The reproducible input is the local 2026/27 catalog plus verified local aliases. Wikidata is queried
project-audit-current.txt:9194: The second pass also uses the locally acquired 2026/27 Transfermarkt master (638 unique players,
project-audit-current.txt:9196: `TRANSFERMARKT-<numeric-id>` is a deterministic stable anchor. Otherwise HIGH requires an exact
project-audit-current.txt:9200: `TRANSFERMARKT` provenance source belongs only to the identity profile.
project-audit-current.txt:9206: `NO_SERIE_A_HISTORY_EXPECTED`. Partial dates such as `YYYY-00-00` are rejected.
project-audit-current.txt:9209: The same FBref ID can propagate that anchor across seasons if no conflict exists. Current/historical
project-audit-current.txt:9211: Two FBref IDs converging on one player, or one FBref ID producing conflicting players, are REVIEW.
project-audit-current.txt:9213: The separate identity readiness endpoint is `GET /api/v1/admin/identity/readiness?season=2026/2027`. Missing historical
project-audit-current.txt:9214: coverage for a legitimate new arrival does not block the Catalog Quality Gate. CSV import is
project-audit-current.txt:9215: idempotent and available at `POST /api/v1/admin/imports/identity/csv`; it updates only NULL player

project-audit-current.txt:9220: --- FILE: documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md ---
project-audit-current.txt:9221: # Player Performance Feature Model V1
project-audit-current.txt:9225: `B49_FEATURES_V1` is an immutable, deterministic evidence layer for the 495 players with an `ACTIVE` 2026/2027 registration. It derives features only from the certified Block 48 Fantacalcio and Transfermarkt history for 2024/2025 and 2025/2026. It does not acquire data, change identity, roles, registrations, clubs or raw statistics.
project-audit-current.txt:9227: The model deliberately publishes component features and a data-confidence score, not a performance ranking. `historical_performance_score` and `cross_league_adjustment` are always `NULL`; the recorded decision is `OVERALL_SCORE_DEFERRED_TO_BLOCK_50`. No source-quality or league-strength coefficients were invented.
project-audit-current.txt:9229: ## Season source selection
project-audit-current.txt:9231: The logical grain is player Ã— historical season. A meaningful Fantacalcio row is preferred because it is the certified Serie A source. Otherwise, Transfermarkt rows classified as `DOMESTIC_LEAGUE` are aggregated across clubs. Domestic cups, international cups, promotion/relegation/play-off competitions and all other rows remain supplemental evidence and never inflate the main season features.
project-audit-current.txt:9233: Fantacalcio `appearances` means PV (partite a voto), not physical appearances. It is therefore stored as `fantacalcio_voted_appearances`; Transfermarkt appearances remain separate. Fantacalcio has no minutes, so minutes and per-90 features are never estimated for it.
project-audit-current.txt:9237: Unknown never becomes zero. Transfermarkt multi-club totals use strict-null aggregation: if any included domestic-league row has an unknown metric, the aggregate metric is `NULL`. Explicit zero remains zero. A per-90 value is emitted only when both its numerator and positive minutes are known:
project-audit-current.txt:9241: Trends are calculated only between comparable source semantics. Transfermarkt-to-Transfermarkt supports minutes and per-90 deltas. Fantacalcio-to-Fantacalcio supports fantasy-average trend. Mixed-source pairs deliberately have no trend.
project-audit-current.txt:9245: Percentiles are calculated independently inside the current P/D/C/A role. They use inclusive 0â€“100 rank and average ranks for ties. Missing values stay `NULL`. Goalkeepers have no goal-rate or assist-rate percentile; their certified Fantacalcio rating, fantasy average, goals conceded and penalties saved remain available.
project-audit-current.txt:9247: Usage is source-specific: Fantacalcio PV and Transfermarkt minutes are ranked separately and are never combined into one numeric population. Rate percentiles require an eligible Transfermarkt sample.
project-audit-current.txt:9251: The V1 threshold is empirical, not arbitrary: the overall 25th percentile of positive, aggregated Transfermarkt domestic-league minutes in the certified current-player history. The generated audit records 297 samples and a threshold of 1,057 minutes. Raw per-90 values remain visible below the threshold, but rate percentiles are `NULL` and `small_sample_flag` is true.
project-audit-current.txt:9255: `data_confidence_score` measures evidence completeness, never player quality. It is the unweighted mean of four transparent components:
project-audit-current.txt:9257: - season coverage: 50 points per available historical season;
project-audit-current.txt:9258: - latest usage evidence: 100 when Fantacalcio PV or Transfermarkt minutes are known, otherwise 0;
project-audit-current.txt:9260: - fantasy evidence: 100 when at least one Fantacalcio season exists, otherwise 0.
project-audit-current.txt:9266: The database key is `(player_id, reference_season_id, algorithm_version)`. The certified importer is append-only: an identical rerun inserts nothing; the same version with changed definitions, fingerprint, context or JSON is rejected. A future algorithm must use a new version and may coexist with V1. Foreign keys, uniqueness, role/history/source bounds, confidence bounds, JSON object checks, SHA-256 shape and the deferred-score policy are enforced by migration V48.
project-audit-current.txt:9268: The input fingerprint is SHA-256 over the algorithm version and canonical selected season rows. Generated timestamps are database metadata and are excluded from the deterministic artifacts.

documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:1: # Fantasy Player Value Model V1
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:5: `B50_FANTASY_VALUE_V1` is a deterministic, rule-based historical fantasy-football value model for the 495 current operational 2026/2027 players. Its only input is the immutable `B49_FEATURES_V1` evidence layer for 2024/2025 and 2025/2026. It does not use age, market value, reputation, league factors, current form, prices, calendar or newly acquired data.
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:7: Fantacalcio is authoritative for fantasy average, rating, PV and goalkeeper evidence. Transfermarkt contributes only certified usage, production and discipline. Missing fantasy evidence for international players remains `NULL`, never zero and never an invented proxy.
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:11: All available components are on 0–100 role-relative scales. Fantasy quality uses 80% Fantacalcio fantasy-average role percentile and 20% a B50-derived role percentile of average rating when both exist. Usage reuses the source-aware B49 usage percentile. Production uses the mean of available B49 goal/assist rate percentiles; Fantacalcio rows use source-and-role-relative latest raw goal/assist percentiles because minutes do not exist. The signals are combined once, avoiding raw/per-90 double counting within a player.
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:13: Consistency is inverse role percentile of absolute comparable-season change and exists only for two same-source seasons. Discipline is the inverse role percentile of certified Transfermarkt discipline events per 90 after B49 small-sample exclusion. Goalkeeper-specific value combines penalties-saved percentile (60%) and inverse goals-conceded-per-PV percentile (40%); raw goals conceded are never used. Offensive production is excluded for goalkeepers.
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:17: - P: fantasy quality 45, usage 30, goalkeeper 20, consistency 5.
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:28: Ranks are per role only. Competition ranking is used for equal unrounded scores, with player ID providing deterministic display order but no semantic tie break. Role percentile is inclusive 0–100 with average ranks for ties. Component/final/percentile display precision is two decimals; contributions use four decimals, while calculations occur before rounding.
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:32: The database grain is player, reference season and algorithm version. Import is append-only and idempotent; changed output under the same key is a conflict. Formula changes require a new version. Source-mix distributions, component coverage/distributions, correlations, anomalies, golden cases and top/bottom ranks are published under `data/statistics/value-model`.
documentation\fantasy-player-value-model-v1.md:34: The principal limitation is structural source coverage: international-only players have no manufactured fantasy quality, Fantacalcio-only players have no minute-based discipline, and profiles with fewer than two valid components are explicitly unranked. This is evidence uncertainty, not low player value.
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:3: Identity enrichment is deliberately separate from player reconciliation and statistical links.
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:4: It never writes `player_source_mappings`, never changes `player_reconciliation_results.sources_count`,
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:7: The reproducible input is the local 2026/27 catalog plus verified local aliases. Wikidata is queried
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:14: The second pass also uses the locally acquired 2026/27 Transfermarkt master (638 unique players,
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:16: `TRANSFERMARKT-<numeric-id>` is a deterministic stable anchor. Otherwise HIGH requires an exact
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:20: `TRANSFERMARKT` provenance source belongs only to the identity profile.
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:26: `NO_SERIE_A_HISTORY_EXPECTED`. Partial dates such as `YYYY-00-00` are rejected.
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:29: The same FBref ID can propagate that anchor across seasons if no conflict exists. Current/historical
documentation\identity-enrichment.md:31: Two FBref IDs converging on one player, or one FBref ID producing conflicting players, are REVIEW.

documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:1: # Player Performance Feature Model V1
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:5: `B49_FEATURES_V1` is an immutable, deterministic evidence layer for the 495 players with an `ACTIVE` 2026/2027 registration. It derives features only from the certified Block 48 Fantacalcio and Transfermarkt history for 2024/2025 and 2025/2026. It does not acquire data, change identity, roles, registrations, clubs or raw statistics.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:7: The model deliberately publishes component features and a data-confidence score, not a performance ranking. `historical_performance_score` and `cross_league_adjustment` are always `NULL`; the recorded decision is `OVERALL_SCORE_DEFERRED_TO_BLOCK_50`. No source-quality or league-strength coefficients were invented.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:9: ## Season source selection
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:11: The logical grain is player × historical season. A meaningful Fantacalcio row is preferred because it is the certified Serie A source. Otherwise, Transfermarkt rows classified as `DOMESTIC_LEAGUE` are aggregated across clubs. Domestic cups, international cups, promotion/relegation/play-off competitions and all other rows remain supplemental evidence and never inflate the main season features.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:13: Fantacalcio `appearances` means PV (partite a voto), not physical appearances. It is therefore stored as `fantacalcio_voted_appearances`; Transfermarkt appearances remain separate. Fantacalcio has no minutes, so minutes and per-90 features are never estimated for it.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:17: Unknown never becomes zero. Transfermarkt multi-club totals use strict-null aggregation: if any included domestic-league row has an unknown metric, the aggregate metric is `NULL`. Explicit zero remains zero. A per-90 value is emitted only when both its numerator and positive minutes are known:
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:21: Trends are calculated only between comparable source semantics. Transfermarkt-to-Transfermarkt supports minutes and per-90 deltas. Fantacalcio-to-Fantacalcio supports fantasy-average trend. Mixed-source pairs deliberately have no trend.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:25: Percentiles are calculated independently inside the current P/D/C/A role. They use inclusive 0–100 rank and average ranks for ties. Missing values stay `NULL`. Goalkeepers have no goal-rate or assist-rate percentile; their certified Fantacalcio rating, fantasy average, goals conceded and penalties saved remain available.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:27: Usage is source-specific: Fantacalcio PV and Transfermarkt minutes are ranked separately and are never combined into one numeric population. Rate percentiles require an eligible Transfermarkt sample.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:31: The V1 threshold is empirical, not arbitrary: the overall 25th percentile of positive, aggregated Transfermarkt domestic-league minutes in the certified current-player history. The generated audit records 297 samples and a threshold of 1,057 minutes. Raw per-90 values remain visible below the threshold, but rate percentiles are `NULL` and `small_sample_flag` is true.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:35: `data_confidence_score` measures evidence completeness, never player quality. It is the unweighted mean of four transparent components:
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:37: - season coverage: 50 points per available historical season;
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:38: - latest usage evidence: 100 when Fantacalcio PV or Transfermarkt minutes are known, otherwise 0;
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:40: - fantasy evidence: 100 when at least one Fantacalcio season exists, otherwise 0.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:46: The database key is `(player_id, reference_season_id, algorithm_version)`. The certified importer is append-only: an identical rerun inserts nothing; the same version with changed definitions, fingerprint, context or JSON is rejected. A future algorithm must use a new version and may coexist with V1. Foreign keys, uniqueness, role/history/source bounds, confidence bounds, JSON object checks, SHA-256 shape and the deferred-score policy are enforced by migration V48.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:48: The input fingerprint is SHA-256 over the algorithm version and canonical selected season rows. Generated timestamps are database metadata and are excluded from the deterministic artifacts.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:52: 1. Export the certified current context with `scripts/statistics/export_player_performance_context.ps1`.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:53: 2. Run `python scripts/statistics/build_player_performance_features.py`.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:54: 3. Run `python -m unittest scripts/statistics/test_player_performance_features.py`.
documentation\player-performance-feature-model-v1.md:57: Primary auditable artifacts live in `data/statistics/features/`: the season base, compact import, wide feature review, definition catalog, source availability matrix, minutes distribution, anomalies and golden-player audit.
